Agenda #1: The meeting approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements while granting full discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their management and supervision.
Agenda #2: Shareholders determined that no dividends or mandatory reserves will be distributed because the company recorded a net loss for the 2025 financial year.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the Board of Commissioners and the Nomination and Remuneration Committee to set the 2026 remuneration for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to appoint a Public Accountant for the annual financial audit and determine professional fees based on Audit Committee recommendations.
